about: Every voice snippet in Floodwood. Record them in this order, one take per numbered item, with ~2 s of silence between items. build_voices.py finds each take in the recording and makes the layered voices.

cues.how: Short chuckle under your breath, like 'heh heh heh'. About 1 second. Make each take a little different.
A genuine laugh at a friend's dumb move. About 2 seconds. Vary them: one 'ha ha ha', one 'heh-heh', one through the nose, one that starts with a snort.
cues.used: most memories; layered into the crowd

cues.how: Cracking up: big, breathless, 3-4 seconds, trailing off into a wheeze. These get stacked 4-5 deep for the group eruptions.
a) calling across the water to a friend.  b) surprised, quick.
a) a whoop as someone jumps in.  b) shorter 'woo!'.
a) egging someone on in a race.  b) one sharp 'Go!'.
a) celebrating.  b) agreeing loudly, 'Yeah!'.
a) 'Dude!' in disbelief.  b) drawn out 'Duuude...'.
a) startled 'Oh!' (kayak wobbling).  b) a long falling groan 'Ohhhh...' (something lost overboard).
a) sharp 'No!'.  b) pleading 'Nooo...'.
a) 'Wait!' calling ahead.  b) 'Wait wait wait!'.
a) 'Come on!' urging.  b) 'C'mon, c'mon!'.
The island chant, shouted across the water. Two takes with different rhythm.
Calling from the bank as the cantaloupe flies.
Losing balance in a kayak.
Cocky, across the water.
Laughing, out of breath.
Half laughing, half panicking.
Being towed, loving it.
Horrified, as they slip.
Quiet, deflated.
